backward_compatibility: make_gaussian_heatmap gains an OPTIONAL component_areas parameter defaulting to None (original fixed-sigma behavior preserved). kub_localizer_dataset gains an OPT-IN size_adaptive_sigma flag defaulting to False. All other callers/pipelines (Phase-13B, Phase-14 refiner) are unaffected.

change_1.current_signature: def make_gaussian_heatmap(image_size: int, centroids, sigma: float) -> np.ndarray:
change_1.proposed_signature: def make_gaussian_heatmap(image_size: int, centroids, sigma: float, component_areas=None, sigma_min: float = 0.35, sigma_max: float = 0.75, scale_ref: float = 4.0) -> np.ndarray:
logic: If component_areas is None: sigma_i = sigma (original behavior).
Else: for each component i, sigma_i = min(sigma_max, max(sigma_min, scale_ref * sqrt(area_i))).
Replace the per-component Gaussian: comp_hm = exp(-((ys-cy)**2 + (xs-cx)**2) / (2 * sigma_i**2)).
Keep canonical center pixel forced to 1.0 (comp_hm[icy, icx] = 1.0).
change_1.effect: Tiny components (small area_i) get a SMALLER sigma -> sharper, higher-contrast peak; large components capped at sigma_max=0.75 (historical behavior).

proposed: Add constructor flag: self.size_adaptive_sigma (bool, default False).

In __getitem__, after obtaining mapped_centroids, also compute per-component pixel area in localizer/heatmap space (count of foreground pixels in each labeled component after mapping to localizer space).
Conditionally pass component_areas to make_gaussian_heatmap only when self.size_adaptive_sigma is True.
When False: call unchanged (fixed self.sigma) -> bit-identical to Phase-13B behavior.
change_2.helper: Extend get_component_centroids_in_localizer_space (heatmap_targets.py:35) to ALSO return per-component area in localizer space, OR add a sibling helper get_component_areas_in_localizer_space; the dataset binds both.

verification_after_apply: Unit: make_gaussian_heatmap with component_areas=None reproduces the pre-change target byte-for-byte.
Unit: a tiny component (area ~2-4 px in heatmap space) yields a tighter peak (smaller sigma) than a large component.
Integration: training the H3 localizer with size_adaptive_sigma=True; confirm VAL zero-proposal TINY decreases vs Phase-13B baseline.
